paragraphs.text: Trilobite is a creature type used for cards that depict a prehistoric marine arthropod with a carapace over the forepart, and a segmented hind part divided longitudinally into three lobes.
Trilobites are predominantly blue -aligned or colorless , though Electryte is mono- red .

The first creature to bear the type was Shore Keeper from Ixalan . Trilobite would return on Scuttling Sliver in Modern Horizons , Cryptic Trilobite in Commander 2020 , and Drownyard Lurker in Modern Horizons 3 .
Electryte which was originally printed as a Beast in Urza's Saga . With the Core Set 2019 rules update the type was also added to Electryte, retroactively making it the first printed trilobite.
Trilobites are found on several planes of the multiverse, including Dominaria , Ikoria , Innistrad , and Ixalan .
Drownyard Lurker is an Innistrad Trilobyte, specifically calling out The Travails as the time period.
Over their long lifespans, the larger of the Ixalan trilobites accumulate vast treasure troves in their guts.
Scuttling Sliver from Modern Horizons is a Sliver Trilobite of unknown origin.
